about.aboutapp: NativeWeather is an application for displaying current weather and forecasts. It also displays current air pollution values and maps for the whole world.
about.openmeteo: Specialized data for air quality index (AQI) and pollution
about.openstreetmap: Provides OpenStreetMap vector basemap tiles for interactive geographic maps
about.openweather: Alternative source for current weather and forecasts

about.weatherapi: The main source of data for current weather, forecasts, astronomical data, and weather map overlays
